instruction: Acquire the cracker box from its original source table, retain it while moving to the other table, and place and release it inside the destination basket/container while staying upright.
scene_contract: Original native two-table SIMPLE scene and asset/hand geometry. Identify source target and destination from current RGB. Preserve both table positions and all objects; no relocation or hidden coordinates.
completion: Native completion records target-container contact without hand contact and its original accumulated criterion. That trigger alone does not prove retained pickup, carrying or correct placement.

Independent audit additionally requires unsupported retained acquisition off the source table, continuous controlled carriage during actual robot relocation, supported placement inside the destination container and release. Native and full-task outcomes remain separate.

Stop physical execution when rollout_finished and complete skill_update. This is a registered learning attempt under SIX-TASK-FIVE-STABLE-V1; it cannot contribute to fixed-candidate stability or frozen evaluation.
phase_guidance: Inspect fresh stereo and named robot state; identify the box, first and second tables, reachable hand clearance and a path without relocating any scene object. If destination is outside view, inspect through bounded robot motion and updated images.

Use experience_select to review the compatible public acquisition/hold sources, successful box-placement release and MobileCheezit1 loss during changed whole-body posture. Native MobileCheezit is a different task; its failed loaded transition is a counterexample, not an achieved carrying skill. No source coordinates or trajectories are defaults.

Achieve a stable reachable stance at the first table, review full-hand meshes and achieved wrist attitude, establish opposing enclosure, then close and test a small lift plus separate hold. Reopen and correct the geometry after loss.

Before loaded movement, verify retained box-hand co-motion, clear the first table and note the current pelvis height/tilt, wrist tracking and actual support drift. Empty-hand approach examples are hypotheses only when carrying.

Use bounded coordinated four-point references to test one small loaded movement at a time. Keep the grasp attitude and payload visually monitored; reobserve after each chunk. Reject lost support or worsening instability; stabilize rather than repeating the same saturated reach.

At the destination table establish a stable stance and clear path for lowering inside the visible basket/container. Open only after support is visually established, then withdraw and inspect if physics remains active. Reserve time for placement and verification; do not invent post-native-terminal dwell.
known_interface_limits: Model_38000 UMI-4/checkpoint PD, native Dex3 mesh geometry, 50Hz tracker and200Hz MuJoCo. Bounded continuous chunks; current observation defines limits.240s physical budget, full Astra turns awaited, paused physics not RTC.
failure_guidance: Separate observation uncertainty, tracking, contact acquisition and task progress. Preserve public evidence, excluded hypotheses and a changed next test. finish_attempt only records a stall; it does not terminate the episode. Follow its returned current observation and next_call to test the changed safe hypothesis in this same episode. Continue until native success/failure, runtime safety/system termination or the physical budget. Do not use reasoning delay, three completed actions or temporary lack of progress as a stop condition. Do not consume remaining budget with idle holds.
prohibited_shortcuts: No object poses/contact truth, hidden reward query, task/evaluator source access, human/external demonstrations, replay as task credit or mid-episode reset.
guidance_status: Task semantics and current interface limits, not an action demonstration. All motion inferred by actor from permitted observations.
